description: Portable shared hooks for the Codex adapter. Review and trust in /hooks; coverage and limitations: .agents/adapters/codex/README.md.

hooks.command: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');let d=process.cwd();for(;;){const f=p.join(d,'.agents','adapters','codex','hooks.js');if(fs.existsSync(f)){process.argv[2]='secret-scanner.cjs';process.exitCode=require(f).main();break;}const n=p.dirname(d);if(n===d)throw new Error('Toolkit hook adapter not found');d=n;}}catch(e){const reason='Codex hook launcher failed: '+e.message;let event='PreToolUse';try{event=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).hook_event_name||event;}catch{}process.stderr.write(reason);process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(!['SessionStart','PostToolUse','Stop','SessionEnd','PreCompact'].includes(event)?{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:reason}}:{continue:false,stopReason:reason}));process.exitCode=0;}"
